idea: How to maintain a water tank
title: Keep Your Home Water Storage Clean and Safe
description: Your domestic water tank works hard behind the scenes to supply clean water for daily tasks. Regular care helps protect your water quality and extends the lifespan of your system. Start by inspecting the exterior and lid every few months to ensure it remains tightly sealed against dust, debris, and insects. Next, check around pipe connections and valves for subtle leaks or corrosion. Over time, natural sediment can settle at the bottom, requiring a system flush. If you observe changes in water pressure, color, or odor, reach out to a licensed plumber for a thorough inspection and professional cleaning.
